function.name: run_agent
function.description: Start a coding agent on a project with a task.

agent.description: Agent name as the user said it, e.g. 'claude', 'opencode', 'codex'. Empty = default agent.

project.description: Project name as the user said it. Empty = current project.

task.description: The task, in the user's words, complete.

model.description: Only if the user names a model.

notify.description: true if the user wants to be told when it finishes.

background.description: true only if the user asks not to show it.

after.description: Agent whose output feeds this one, if the user chains them.

function.name: agent_status
function.description: What agents are running, or what one agent is doing. Use summarize=true to read and summarize its output.

agent.description: Agent or project name; empty = all.

function.name: send_to_agent
function.description: Send a follow-up message or answer to a running agent.

function.name: stop_agent
function.description: Stop a running agent. Always asks the user to confirm.

function.name: voice_control
function.description: Control EzAgent's listening: hang up, mute, unmute, repeat last answer, watch an agent.

function.name: remember
function.description: Save a short durable fact about the user or a project alias, after the user asks you to remember it.
